messages:
maya: heads-up — onboarding sampleapp (rerank flow) flaky when embed-batcher + auth-retry collide. getting vector_dim_mismatch during a transient retry.

samir: which SDK and which helper? can you paste the helper config?

maya: Node `@redwood/inference` v0.8.0, using `embed-batcher` helper from sampleapp. config below (sanitized):

```json
{"items":[{"id":"doc1","text":"alpha"},{"id":"doc2","text":"beta"}],"batching":{"max_batch_size":16,"pad_to_multiple":8},"use_helper":true}
```

maya: Repro pattern: first POST succeeds (200) and embeddings are 1024-dim. Token refresh triggers and sdk retries by re-assembling a padded batch; second POST contains zero vectors but they end up as length 2048 and server returns 400 `vector_dim_mismatch`.

emily: odd — python sampleapp not seeing this?

maya: correct. Python `redwood-sdk` v1.3.1 pads consistently. Node seems to read model info from the first successful response but then on retry falls back to a default dim from a constants file (2048).

samir: can you paste the raw server error body for the 400?

maya: error body: ```{"error":{"code":"vector_dim_mismatch","message":"expected 1024 got 2048","meta":{"expected":1024,"got":2048}},"trace":"req_xyz"}```

maya: logs:
[09:10:01] POST /v1/embeddings 200 len=9216 auth=ok model=open-embed-1024-v2
[09:10:02] POST /v1/embeddings 400 len=5120 auth=refresh

maya: The second POST content-length is smaller oddly because zeros compressed (or encoded differently) but vector length claim in body indicates 2048.

darnell: sounds like two separate issues: (1) retry path reconstructs padding using global DEFAULT_EMBED_DIM instead of per-call model.dim, (2) when parsing server success envelope the helper caches model.dim on a shared singleton instead of per-request context — so subsequent concurrent calls race.

emily: also check response format parity — our router sometimes returns `vectors` array vs `data`+`embedding` shape. If helper normalizer mistook an error envelope for a success envelope it could mutate the vectors array.

samir: repro steps I recommend: force token expiry, run node sampleapp with `DEBUG=redwood:batch*` and `REDWOOD_SDK_CACHE=0`, capture nginx access logs and raw HTTP bodies. try both pad_to_multiple 1 and 8 to see variance.

maya: quick workaround for customers: set pad_to_multiple:1 or pin Node SDK to 0.7.x. we've opened a GH issue and added a sample repro script.

maya: GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/423 - titles "embed-batcher retry builds wrong pad dim on token refresh". attached logs and curl repro.

devex-bot: Issue created: sampleapp#423 by maya - "embed-batcher retry builds wrong pad dim on token refresh".

darnell: I'll put together a fix: change helper to (a) never mutate global model.dim, (b) if retry uses error envelope, fall back to original request shape stored in call-scoped metadata, (c) add unit test that simulates auth-refresh retry + pad_to_multiple >1.

samir: also add an integration test against the mock server that sends both `data`-style and `vectors`-style responses to assert the normalizer doesn't mutate input vector sizes.

emily: one more note — update docs/sampleapp README to call out `pad_to_multiple` tradeoffs and recommend small multiples for starts.

maya: thanks y'all. leaving the thread, will follow PR. :thumbsup:
